Who I Am

A personal introduction, my current learning journey and the goals I'm working toward.

Hi, I'm Durjoy Sharma.

I'm a student from Bangladesh and I'm currently learning Web Development from the beginning. At the moment, my main focus is HTML and understanding how websites are structured.

I enjoy technology, gaming, creative work and learning new things. I like turning ideas into small projects and improving through practice.

My goal is to build a strong foundation first, then gradually learn CSS, JavaScript and other Web Development technologies. I want to keep growing step by step and create useful things with what I learn.
